confidence_notes: Recent Guangzhou cost-of-living data give a useful basis for restaurant meals, cappuccino and domestic draft beer. Cocktail and wine estimates are less certain; they use local price relationships to beer with a limited nightlife-price benchmark. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates from general knowledge, without live listing checks.
comparable_city_reasoning: Guangzhou's recent city-level cost-of-living prices provide the primary basis; no comparable city was needed.
